perf.summary: `prev == 0 ? 0 : left[prev]` recomputed though the prev!=0 copy block already loaded those values.
perf.currentCost: In Build, lines 11-15 (under `if (prev != 0)`) copy left[prev]/right[prev]/tree[prev] into node. Then lines 23-24 recompute `prev == 0 ? 0 : left[prev]` and `prev == 0 ? 0 : right[prev]`, re-loading left[prev]/right[prev] and re-evaluating the prev predicate. Same pattern in Update lines 50/52.
perf.proposedChange: Hoist `int lp = prev != 0 ? left[prev] : 0; int rp = prev != 0 ? right[prev] : 0;` once near the top, store into left[node]/right[node], and pass lp/rp to the recursive calls. This both populates the node and feeds recursion from registers instead of re-reading memory and re-branching.
perf.rationale: Removes a duplicate memory load and a duplicate branch per recursion level on the persistent build/update hot path (O(log n) nodes per operation). Values come from registers already in flight, shortening the dependency chain to the recursive call.
perf.risk: Must preserve that when prev==0 the recursive child arg is 0 and left[node]/right[node] end up correct (they are overwritten by the returned child id afterward anyway). Behavior identical; pure CSE.

perf.summary: Two byte-identical query functions; consolidate to one to reduce code size and improve I-cache/inlining.
perf.currentCost: PersistentSegmentQuery.RunInt32 (lines 60-67) and DynamicSegmentQuery.Run (lines 96-103) have identical bodies. Burst compiles both, doubling generated code for the same operation and splitting the instruction cache footprint.
perf.proposedChange: Have one delegate to the other (or expose a single shared internal query and keep thin public wrappers). Wrappers marked AggressiveInlining so call sites pay nothing.
perf.rationale: Less duplicated machine code improves instruction-cache locality on mobile and keeps a single optimized version. No behavioral change since bodies are identical.
perf.risk: Purely organizational; must keep both public entry points for API stability (ergonomics) — make one forward to the other rather than deleting. Zero semantic change.
